Q84/Q95/Q103 source-comparison figures remain ungraded despite bilingual descriptions, and Q111 ALL-correct is excluded from scoring. Source-reviewed Q121 uses non-original horizontal layout. Q38 English grammar choices and Q58 scientific isotope choices are source-literal in Tamil study mode; Q58 remains ALL-correct ungraded. 130 of 137 readable entries have either Tamil study translations (122) or already-Tamil source originals (8). Only seven intentionally remain source-language-only (Q15/Q37/Q39/Q40–42/Q47). Q114–116 remain missing.
